actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.enrich_companies.description: Enrich companies details using requestId and company IDs from search results
actions.enrich_companies.props.searchRes: The results from the Search Companies step
actions.search_companies.description: Search for companies with filters and pagination
actions.search_companies.props.requestBo: The JSON body for the search request. Do not include pagination (pages), it will be added automatically.
actions.search_companies.props.resultLim: Maximum number of companies to return. The maximum is 10000 results.
auth.description: Please enter the API Key obtained from Lusha.
